subtopics.title: Introduction to Reading as a Cognitive Process
subtopics.description: This subtopic introduces the concept of reading as a cognitive process, explaining how the brain processes written language. It covers basic terminology and how reading involves multiple cognitive functions.

subtopics.title: The Stages of Reading: From Perception to Comprehension
subtopics.description: This subtopic delves into the different stages of reading, including perception, encoding, and comprehension. It explains how each stage contributes to the overall reading process and how they interact with each other.

subtopics.title: Decoding: The Process of Converting Symbols to Meaning
subtopics.description: This subtopic focuses on the decoding process, which involves converting written symbols into meaningful language. It covers the role of phonological awareness, orthographic processing, and vocabulary knowledge in decoding.

subtopics.title: Comprehension: Understanding the Meaning of Text
subtopics.description: This subtopic explores the process of comprehension, which involves making sense of the text. It covers strategies for improving comprehension, such as predicting, inferring, and summarizing, and the role of background knowledge in comprehension.

subtopics.title: Memory in Reading: How We Remember What We Read
subtopics.description: This subtopic examines the role of memory in reading, including short-term and long-term memory. It discusses how readers encode information and retrieve it later, and how memory can affect reading comprehension and retention.

subtopics.title: Individual Differences in Reading: Factors Affecting Reading Performance
subtopics.description: This subtopic looks at individual differences in reading, including factors such as age, education level, and learning disabilities. It discusses how these factors can impact reading performance and strategies for supporting diverse learners.

subtopics.title: The Role of Technology in Reading: Enhancing Cognitive Processes
subtopics.description: This subtopic explores how technology can support and enhance reading processes. It covers the use of assistive technologies for individuals with reading difficulties and the role of digital reading materials in improving reading skills.
